title: Zanello's unimodality strengthening of Bergeron's Gaussian inequality
statement:
Let $a,b,c,d$ be positive integers satisfying

$$
0<a\leq b<c\leq d,\qquad ad=bc.
$$

Consider the symmetric Gaussian-polynomial difference

$$
\binom{b+c}{b}_q-\binom{a+d}{a}_q.
$$

**Zanello's conjecture.** Its coefficients are non-negative and unimodal. The source describes this as a strengthening of the preceding Gaussian inequality and notes that Zanello treated the special case $a\leq3$; the general assertion remains open in the supplied text.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.03395

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of April 2023).
source_name: Tewodros Amdeberhan and David Callan, “Gaussian inequality”, arXiv:2304.03395 (2023).
